outcome: Risk of early-onset neonatal bacterial sepsis (EOS)
EOS by specific bacteria (group B Streptococcus, Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli)
cohort: 1,971,346 live singleton infants born in Sweden between 1997 and 2016
finding: Maternal overweight and obesity were found to be associated with an increased risk of EOS, particularly in term infants, with a dose-response relationship observed.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to mediate half of the association between maternal overweight/obesity and EOS risk.
